title: Christmas and New Year in Madeira 2026: Lights, Market Night and Fireworks
description: Christmas and New Year in Madeira 2026: lights from 1 December, Noite do Mercado on 23 December, Funchal fireworks on 31 December, and a sunset trip by sea.
heroAlt: A private Chifbay boat off the Funchal coast at golden hour

images.prompt: Wide photograph of Funchal bay at dusk in December, the hillside amphitheatre of the city glittering with warm Christmas lights above the marina and calm dark blue water.
images.alt: Funchal bay at dusk with Christmas lights glowing across the hillside

images.prompt: Photograph of a small white private motorboat cruising along the Madeira south coast in soft golden winter light, with the green cliffs of Cabo Girão in the background.
images.alt: A small white motorboat on the Madeira coast in golden winter light

images.prompt: Photograph of a festive evening street in Funchal old town with strings of Christmas lights over a cobbled lane and people strolling past a market stall.
images.alt: A Funchal street decorated with Christmas lights in the evening
